core_summary: Plants are autotrophic organisms that synthesize their own food via Photosynthesis: Carbon Dioxide + Water +(Sunlight / Chlorophyll)-> Glucose + Oxygen. Chlorophyll inside leaf chloroplasts captures solar energy. Stomata regulated by guard cells control gas exchange (CO2 intake, O2 release) and transpiration. Xylem vessels transport water and soil minerals upwards unidirectionally from roots to leaves. Phloem vessels translocate synthesized food (sugars) multidirectionally throughout the plant. Plants also respire continuously day and night. Indian scientist Kamala Sohonie made landmark contributions to plant respiration research.
key_concepts: To test a green leaf for the presence of starch produced via photosynthesis.

key_terms.definition: The loss of water vapor from aerial plant parts (primarily stomata), generating suction pull for mineral absorption.

key_takeaways: Plants release oxygen only during daytime when photosynthesis occurs under light. At night, plants consume oxygen for cellular respiration.
